title: Stop showing title fragments as task names

requirements.text: Agents can name a task or goal as they create it, and creating one without a name tells them to give one
The app shows a chosen name, or else the real title, never a first-three-words fragment
requirements.check: swift test and eye: driver screenshot

requirements.text: Agents are told to name what they create, in the installed rules and in the rule every app session gets

evidence: tests/run.mjs naming block passes: new and goal add/propose take --short, taken name refuses with nothing created, unnamed creation prints the nudge. 387 passed

testAHeadingIsARealNameOrTheRealTitle passes; real Lunenburg panel.png shows What the 360 unlanded tables and 166 gaps actually are, and Report data for the chosen goal name; lunenburg git status unchanged by the run
agent/goals.md and agent/tickets.md carry --short; namesRule contains --short, asserted by test; tests check tickets.md

answers.observed: panel.png viewed on real Lunenburg data, 92 app and 387 CLI tests
answers.cause: cause is measured: named False on every fragment in the Lunenburg snapshot, because nothing asked for a name
answers.absence: no real agent has yet been seen choosing a name, since running sessions get the app rule only when next launched
answers.assumption: my assumption: a longer real title beats a short fragment, which makes rows taller until tasks are named
answers.falsify: an unnamed task still showing three words in the app, or agents ignoring --short
